changelog.3.7.0: Phase 9 (P7) Extension Tier Gating: BJ_TIER_GATE utility (tierGate.js) gates autofill behind subscription tiers. Free tier: extension installed + scanning works but autofill disabled with upgrade CTA. Starter tier: autofill enabled for 5 applications/day, counter resets midnight UTC. Pro tier: unlimited autofill. dashboard:ping now returns tier + tierStatus with daily usage. New dashboard:setTier message for dashboard to push tier updates. dashboard:apply and dashboard:fillCurrent gated through BJ_TIER_GATE.check() before processing. Usage recorded via BJ_TIER_GATE.recordUsage() on successful fill. Dashboard apply-workflow.js checks auto_apply entitlement before dispatching browser fill, shows upgrade prompt if blocked.
changelog.3.6.0: Phase 8 (P6) Extension Security Hardening: Triple-layer origin verification — BJ_ORIGIN_GUARD validates sender URL (Layer 2) + tab URL (Layer 3) on top of Chrome's externally_connectable (Layer 1). Rate limiting at 60 msgs/min. PII encryption at rest — BJ_CRYPTO uses AES-GCM-256 with PBKDF2 key derived from extension install ID. authSession + userProfile encrypted in chrome.storage.local with transparent migration from plaintext. Manifest hardened: removed optional_host_permissions for Indeed/Workday (not yet needed), removed dev/staging from externally_connectable, added CSP directive (script-src 'self', object-src 'self').
changelog.3.5.0: Phase 7 (P10-C) LinkedIn Easy Apply: linkedin-easy-apply.js (full handler replacing stub). Multi-step modal navigation with MutationObserver step detection. Custom [role='listbox'] dropdown filling. City typeahead with 1000ms autocomplete delay + ArrowDown+Enter fallback. Resume radio card selection (not file upload). Smart question mapping (visa, authorization, relocation, salary, etc). 2-min stuck detection timeout. Daily limit detection. 20s loading screen timeout. Unfollow company before submit. Human-like delays (200-600ms). manifest.json: v3.5.0, added linkedin.com/jobs/* to content_scripts. background.js: added linkedin-easy-apply to capabilities. contentScript.js: added linkedin-easy-apply ATS_HANDLERS entry with pathPattern. apply-workflow.js: added linkedin to _guessAtsSource.
changelog.3.4.0: Phase 6 (P5) Apply Pathway Rework: externally_connectable in manifest for dashboard-extension communication. onMessageExternal handler in background.js (dashboard:ping, dashboard:apply, dashboard:getState, dashboard:fillCurrent). handleDashboardApply opens ATS URL in new tab + fills via content script. Dashboard apply-workflow.js v5.29: extension detection via dashboard:ping, dual-path submission (API for Recruitee/Greenhouse, browser fill for Lever/Ashby/Workable via extension, manual fallback), getSubmissionPath routing, dispatchBrowserFill dispatch, _buildProfileForFill profile builder.

changelog.3.8.0: Phase 10 (P9) JD Extraction + Tracking: Enhanced per-ATS JD selectors with broader fallbacks and title/company extraction. New jdMatcher.js computes instant JD-to-resume compatibility score (keyword + tech keyword matching, weighted scoring, confidence levels). New autoTracker.js auto-tracks form submissions to Supabase pending_applications (detects submit events, confirmation pages, records both confirmed and unconfirmed submissions). background.js adds ats:submitDetected/ats:confirmationDetected handlers, auto-scores JD on page detect, new dashboard:getJDMatch external message. contentScript.js v3.8.0 integrates inline submit tracking without requiring ApplicationTracker import.
changelog.3.9.0: Phase 11 (P10-E) Indeed + Workday: indeed.js handler with fuzzy label matching (40+ regex patterns), multi-step form navigation, smart question answering, employer-customized form support. workday.js handler with data-automation-id field mapping, multi-page wizard navigation (My Information → Experience → Questions → Disclosures → Review), custom Workday dropdown filling, resume-first upload for auto-populate, EEO/voluntary disclosure handling. Both handlers support human-like delays, resume upload, and checkbox/radio/select filling.
